sections.section: RULE - Sindh Local Government Election Rules 2000
sections.description:
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS RULES, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st October, 2000]
No.LGD/Legis-II/2000, dated
21-10-2000:---In exercise of the powers conferred upon him under section 39
of the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000, the Government of
Sindh are pleased to make the following rules;
CHAPTER - I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) These rules may Sindh Local Government Elections Rules,
2000.
(2) They shall come into force at
once and shall notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in any other
rules on the subject.
2. Definitions.--In these
rules unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context;
(i)
"Appellate Authority" means an appellate authority appointed under these
rules;
(ii)
"ballot paper" means a ballot paper given in Forms X(A), X(B), X(C)
or X(D) in the rules;
(iii)
"ballot paper account" means a ballot paper account prepared under
these, rules;
(iv)
"candidate" means a person nominated for election as a member;
(v)
"Contesting candidate" means a candidate who has been validly
nominated for election as a member of a ward or as a Nazim or a Naib -Nazim of
a District, Taluka, Town or Union, and has not withdrawn his nomination on or
before the withdrawal day;
(vi)
"Council" means a Zila Council, A Taluka Council or a Town Council
and a Union Council constituted under the Ordinance;
(vii)
"Delimitation Officer" means a person appointed for the delimitation
of a ward of a Union Council and includes an Assistant Delimitation Officer
performing the functions of a Delimitation Officer;
(viii)
"electoral roll" means electoral rolls prepared under, section 18 of
the Ordinance;
(ix)
"election petition" means a petition under the Ordinance or these
rules calling an election in question;
(x)
"election tribunal" means an election tribunal appointed the
Ordinance or these rules for the trial of an election petition;
(xi)
"form" means a form appended to these rules;
(xii)
"material irregularity" means non-compliance of the provisions of
these rules which materially affect the result of art election;
(xiii)
"minority community" includes persons belonging to the Christian,
Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist and Parsi communities, a person of the Qadiani Group or
the Lahori Group (who call themselves 'Ahmadis' or by any other name) or a
Bahai or any other person who is a 'non-Muslim' as described in Article 260 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973.
(xiv)
"Nomination day" means a day appointed under these rules for the
nomination of candidates;
(xv)
"Ordinance" means the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance,
2000;
(xvi)
"Polling agent" means a polling agent of a candidate appointed under
these rules;
(xvii)
"Polling day" means the day, on which poll is taken for election of a
member;
(xviii)
"Polling Officer" means a polling officer appointed under these
rules;
(xix)
"Polling Station" means a premises where arrangements are made for a
poll;
(xx)
"Presiding Officer" means a Presiding Officer appointed under these
rules and includes an Assistant Presiding Officer exercising powers and
performing the functions of a Presiding Officer;
(xxi)
"Provincial Election Commissioner" means the Provincial Election
Commissioner, Sindh;
(xxii)
"Publish" includes exhibition at a prominent place accessible to the
public;
(xxiii)
"Returned candidate" means a candidate who has been declared elected
as a member of a Council or a Nazim or a Naib-Nazim of a Union, Taluka/Town or
a District;
(xxiv)
"Returning officer" means Returning Officer appointed under these
rules and includes Assistant Returning Officer exercising powers and performing
functions of a Returning Officer;
(xxv)
"Rules" means the Sindh Local Government Elections Rules, 2000;
(xxvi)
"Validly nominated candidate" means a candidate whose nomination has
been accepted under these rules;
(xxvii)
"withdrawal day" means day fixed under these rules on or before which
candidature may be withdrawn.
